console.rejection:
Dear applicant,

Thank you for applying to fix button 3. After careful review, we regret to inform you that button 3 cannot be fixed. Button 3 has always been sticky. Button 3 will always be sticky. It is part of the experience.

Your application has been placed in the coin return slot. Please log in again.

P.S. Rejected applicants are not allowed at /staff. Please do not try the password "password" there. It is a terrible password and we know you will.

Regards,
tomomai AI (Head of Talent, Head of Roasting)
